name: adreceipt
description: Verifiable agentic advertising with policy-bound settlement receipts.

scripts.build:all: npm run contracts:build && npm run graph:build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm run sdk:build && npm run cre:build
scripts.test:all: npm run test:contracts && npm run graph:test && npm --prefix backend test && npm run sdk:test && npm run cre:test
scripts.format:check: biome format backend/src/mcp backend/examples backend/src/domain backend/src/privy backend/src/receipts backend/src/server backend/src/v2 backend/src/scripts/settle-v2.ts frontend/app frontend/components frontend/lib frontend/next.config.ts sdk/src scripts/deploy-settlement.ts scripts/ticket-vectors.ts scripts/cre-placement-fixture.ts test/PlacementSettlementV1.test.ts test/FrontendQuote.test.ts test/PlacementTicketV2.test.ts
scripts.lint:v1: biome lint backend/src/mcp backend/examples backend/src/domain backend/src/privy backend/src/receipts backend/src/server backend/src/v2 backend/src/scripts/settle-v2.ts frontend/app frontend/components frontend/lib frontend/next.config.ts sdk/src scripts/deploy-settlement.ts scripts/ticket-vectors.ts scripts/cre-placement-fixture.ts
scripts.quality:v1: npm run format:check && npm run lint:v1
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm run cre:typecheck
scripts.verify:all: npm run build:all && npm run test:all && npm run typecheck:all
scripts.cre:build: cd cre/placement-authorization && mkdir -p wasm && bun node_modules/@chainlink/cre-sdk/bin/cre-compile.ts main.ts wasm/workflow.wasm
scripts.cre:simulate: cd cre && cre workflow simulate placement-authorization --target staging-settings --non-interactive --trigger-index 0 --env ../.env
scripts.cre:simulate:ineligible: cd cre && cre workflow simulate placement-authorization --target staging-settings --config ./config.ineligible.json --non-interactive --trigger-index 0 --env ../.env
